summary: Moves films and series everyone has watched to a holding folder so your disks do not fill up.
does: Library clean-up moves films and series that everyone has watched, or that nobody has watched for a long time, to a holding folder, so a small server's disks do not fill up. It never deletes anything, and each item can be put back.

Rules have settings, such as how many days since anyone last watched. Anything marked as a favourite, part way through, in a collection or tagged keep stays. A Preview lists what would move before anything does, and nothing moves each day until you turn that on.
for: For people with a small server whose disks are filling up with films and series that nobody is watching any more, and who want a careful clean-up they can undo instead of deleting.
needs: Jellyfin added to Starboard first. It also uses the Reelix key and the holding folder in your media folder. Starboard needs plug-in API 1.14 or later.
shows: One dashboard card, Holding folder, showing how much is in the holding folder, how many items are held and when it checks next. Its tab has the rules, a Libraries page, Always keep settings, a Preview page and a Holding folder page with a Put back button beside each item.
unclear: Is Reelix required, or does the plug-in work with Jellyfin alone? The manifest needs list only Jellyfin but permissions include reelix:key.
